# Gatus

Plugin ID `gatus`. Endpoint health.

The Status page lists the endpoints Gatus checks, grouped, each with its recent history. A failing
check is an attention item on the Overview: critical in a group of
`plugins.gatus.criticalGroups`, a warning otherwise. The hardware plugin can show a machine as up
or down by one of these checks.

## What it shows

### Pages

| Page | Path |
|---|---|
| Service status | `/status` |

### Contributions

It contributes attention items.

### Topics

Published on `/api/v1/stream` and `/api/v1/topics/{topic}`:

| Topic | Payload | What |
|---|---|---|
| `gatus.status` | `StatusData` | Endpoint health checks. |

The Status page lists the groups of `plugins.gatus.criticalGroups` first, then the others
alphabetically.

## Dependencies

A change to a plugin's settings restarts it and the plugins that require or use it.

- **Used by** [Hardware](hardware.md) and [Kubernetes](kubernetes.md).

## Settings

Every setting is under `plugins.gatus` in the config file and is also in the [configuration reference](../configuration.md#pluginsgatus), with the rules for all of them: the layers, the `_FILE` form of each variable and secret references. _Restart_ marks a setting that applies only when dash restarts; a change to any other restarts the plugin in place.

| Setting | Variable | Type | Default | Secret | Restart | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `plugins.gatus.type` | `DASH_PLUGINS_GATUS_TYPE` | string | - | no | no | The plugin type. dash runs one instance per type, so this is empty or the section name. |
| `plugins.gatus.enabled` | `DASH_PLUGINS_GATUS_ENABLED` | boolean | - | no | no | false turns the plugin off: its topics are removed, and the web UI drops its rail entry, palette entries, overview tiles and panels and shows a switched-off page at its address. Unset turns it on when it has the settings it needs (rustfs is off unless enabled: true, because nothing in its settings says an object store exists); a plugin without them is disabled ("not configured: set plugins.<id>.url", naming the setting to make) and the web UI hides its pages. true with settings missing or invalid makes it unconfigured, which hides its pages too. This is how prometheus, alertmanager, gatus, victorialogs, proxmox, hardware, ssh, kubernetes, flux, cnpg, rustfs, grafana, headlamp and launcher behave, and a change to any of their settings applies live: that plugin restarts, and so do the plugins that use or require it (a prometheus change restarts proxmox, hardware, kubernetes, cnpg and rustfs; a gatus change restarts hardware and kubernetes; a proxmox change restarts hardware; a kubernetes change restarts proxmox, flux and cnpg; a grafana change restarts alertmanager). |
| `plugins.gatus.url` | `DASH_PLUGINS_GATUS_URL` | string | - | no | no | Base URL of the service, e.g. http://host:8080. Empty turns the source off: dash makes no request and its panels show "source not configured". |
| `plugins.gatus.auth.basic.username` | `DASH_PLUGINS_GATUS_AUTH_BASIC_USERNAME` | string | - | no | no | User name. |
| `plugins.gatus.auth.basic.password` | `DASH_PLUGINS_GATUS_AUTH_BASIC_PASSWORD` | string | - | yes | no | Password: a literal, env:NAME, file:/path or k8s:<namespace>/<name>#<key> (read from that Kubernetes Secret by the kubernetes plugin, which must run and be allowed to read it). Set together with username. |
| `plugins.gatus.auth.bearerToken` | `DASH_PLUGINS_GATUS_AUTH_BEARER_TOKEN` | string | - | yes | no | Bearer token sent as Authorization: Bearer: a literal, env:NAME, file:/path or k8s:<namespace>/<name>#<key> (read from that Kubernetes Secret by the kubernetes plugin, which must run and be allowed to read it). Not together with basic. |
| `plugins.gatus.tls.caFile` | `DASH_PLUGINS_GATUS_TLS_CA_FILE` | string | - | no | no | Path of a PEM file with the certificate authority that signed the service's certificate, added to the system roots. Empty uses the system roots only. |
| `plugins.gatus.tls.insecureSkipVerify` | `DASH_PLUGINS_GATUS_TLS_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY` | boolean | - | no | no | Skip verifying the service's certificate and host name. Anyone on the network path can then impersonate the service: prefer caFile. |
| `plugins.gatus.criticalGroups` | `DASH_PLUGINS_GATUS_CRITICAL_GROUPS` | list of strings (JSON) | - | no | no | Gatus groups whose failing checks are critical (compared without regard to case); a failing check in any other group is a warning. The Status page lists these groups first. Empty makes every failure a warning. A JSON list in the environment. |
| `plugins.gatus.pageSize` | `DASH_PLUGINS_GATUS_PAGE_SIZE` | integer | `30` | no | no | Check results Gatus returns per endpoint (the pageSize query parameter); the Status page draws them as the endpoint's history. Greater than zero. |

## Actions

None: the plugin only reads.

## Demo twin

With `DASH_DEMO=true` dash runs the plugin's demo twin instead: the same manifest, enabled and configured whatever the settings say, publishing made-up data from the fake lab in `internal/demo/world` and contacting nothing.
